verdict.rationale: NetHunt's own marketing says setup takes minutes: sync email, invite the team, add customers. It also documents customizable and creatable pipelines, which covers the self-serve, fast-to-pipeline core. However, there is no documented bulk import or migration path for bringing in existing real data, and the speed claim rests on vendor copy alone. Missing for 10: documented CSV/spreadsheet import or migration from another CRM, a self-serve onboarding guide, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the under-an-hour claim.

support.subject: As a founder, I can go from signup to a working pipeline with my real data in under an hour, without an implementation partner

citations.quote: Sync your email, invite your team, add customers — you're ready to go in minutes.
Modify fields, pipeline stages, views, and automations to match your unique processes.
